sentences.text:
Shri Aseem Dixit, Government Advocate for the
respondent/State.
Record of the Courts below has been received.

Heard on I.A.No.16257/2018 under Section 5 of the limitation Act for condonation of delay on the ground that the petitioner had gone to Lucknow in pursuit of his livelihood; therefore, he could not file the revision within time; therefore, there was a delay of 1239 days in filing this criminal revision.
The application is supported by an affidavit.
Since petitioner is in custody, I.A.No.16257/2018 is allowed and the delay stands condoned.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State accepts notice on behalf of the respondent/State; as such, no further notice is required.
Heard on I.A.No.16256/2018 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of petitioner Zakir.

A perusal of the record reveals that petitioner stands convicted under Section 7/15 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of six months and fine in the sum of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation.
HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (JAKIR Vs B.S. YADAV)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (JAKIR Vs B.S. YADAV
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has been in custody since 12.09.2018; therefore, it has been prayed that the petitioner be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State has opposed the application.
However, keeping in view the quantum of sentence imposed upon the petitioner and the period already undergone by him, in the opinion of this Court, he deserve to be enlarged on bail.

However,
it will have to be ensured that he does not flee from justice in future.

Jakir vs B.S. Yadav on 23 October, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163223988/

Consequently, this first application (I.A.No. 16256/2018) for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of petitioner Jakir is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount if not already deposited on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 80,000/- with two solvent, local sureties in the sum of Rs.40,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 03.04.2019 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this behalf, the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the petitioner shall stand suspended and he shall be released on bail.
Certified copy as per rules.
(C.V. Sirpurkar) Judge vai Date: 2018.10.23 23:44:40 -07'00'
